newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.041PTS TO 103.366.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BICS100 BOND INDEX RISES 0.041PTS TO 103.366.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.041 points in Monday's trading to 103.366 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.811 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.078 points to 100.953, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.008 points to 2.351 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.589 points to 1,025.606.
